stem.text: Let \( f(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{x^{2} - 25}{x + 5}, & x < -5 \\ kx + m, & -5 \le x \le -4 \\ 3 x^{2} + 7, & x > -4 \end{cases} \), where k and m are constants. Find the values of k and m for which f is continuous for all real numbers. Show that the function value at each boundary agrees with both one sided limits.

answer_key.label: \( k = 65 \) and \( m = 315 \), because the middle branch must equal -10 at \( x = -5 \) and 55 at \( x = -4 \).

worked_solution.text: For \( x < -5 \), \( \frac{x^{2} - 25}{x + 5} = x - 5 \), so the limit from the left at \( x = -5 \) is -10. The middle branch gives \( f(-5) = -5k + m \), so \( -5k + m = -10 \).
worked_solution.rule_named: match the branches at the first boundary

worked_solution.text: At \( x = -4 \) the middle branch gives \( f(-4) = -4k + m \) and the last branch approaches 55, so \( -4k + m = 55 \).
worked_solution.rule_named: match the branches at the second boundary

worked_solution.text: Subtracting the equations gives \( k = 65 \), and then \( m = 315 \).
